HAB-1 payload box, 31 Oct 2026

The tested cradle v4 (tab and slot) inside foam blocks and a 1 inch thermocol ice box. The case, its Pi plate and its straps are the real CAD (cad/v4). Every other part is a box: its tag says whether the size is CAD, datasheet or assumed. The layout is a proposal for hand assembly, checked below. Steps: hab1-launch/docs/06-payload-assembly.md.

Layout checks (run by the generator)

Order of assembly

  1. Floor cap on the bench; drop the 4 walls into its slots.
  2. Pi plate on the y+ wall; Pi on the plate.
  3. Boards on backing cards: Heltec and M9N (x-), NodeMCU, boost, SIM800L (y-), BMP280 (y+).
  4. Bank and LiPos on the floor; straps over the bank.
  5. GPS antennas under the lid, face up.
  6. Cables: route, then strain relief.
  7. Pre-close checklist; lid on, 8 snaps.
  8. Foam blocks; cradle into the ice box; camera, MS5611, duck; close.
